thread:
Ibrahim Noor: Greenfield week0 blockers before Friday cutover: (1) final audit-log shape & delivery, (2) customer CMK ownership + rotation cadence. Can we lock these down today?

Claire Wu: They sent a sample for logs. Pasting here so runbook has it: 
```json
{"meta":{"tenant":"greenfield","env":"prod"},"ts":"2026-03-23T09:07:00Z","event":"inference","model":"rwd-7b","req_tokens":28,"resp_tokens":96,"redacted":true}
```

Diego Ramos: KMS question: do they insist on CMK in their account? If yes, we must ensure our service is only granted crypto ops and cannot alter rotation/policy.

Ibrahim Noor: Correct — customer-managed CMK in their AWS account. Rotation cadence: they prefer 60 days, but asked if we can accept rotation without updating client configs (aliasing). They explicitly said Redwood must not be a key admin.

kms-bot: Security check (auto): - Audit logs must include tenant + ts + event id. - Mask PII before log export. - KMS policy: customer-admin only; grant our service principal only Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. - Deny ScheduleKeyDeletion and DisableKey for our principal.

Claire Wu: Networking: Greenfield will NAT on their side with 3 Elastic IPs. They asked which public IPs our Private side would present for any callback traffic. We'll document both sides: customer NAT preferred; fallback is to allowlist our egress IPs for short test windows.

Diego Ramos: Draft IAM snippet for their cross-account role and KMS line for runbook: 
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::777666555444:role/greenfield-redwood"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:777666555444:key/abcd-ef12-3456"}]}
```

Ibrahim Noor: Can we do a 20-min call at 14:00 PT to confirm the key policy and the three Elastic IPs? I'll invite Greenfield security and their network lead.

onboard-bot: runbook updated by Claire Wu : added steps "audit-jsonl-sample", "customer-cmk-60d", "egress-elastic-ips". Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Greenfield/runbook (internal)

Claire Wu: After the call I'll post the runbook diff and the KMS policy template to their security alias. Also adding cert fingerprint exchange step for log collector mTLS.

Diego Ramos: I'll follow up with the exact policy snippet and the egress IPs we can expose if they need them for testing.

Ibrahim Noor: Great. I'll capture post-call notes here and mark ready-for-cutover once we have: 1) CMK ARN + key policy posted by Greenfield, 2) three Elastic IPs and collector FQDN + cert fingerprint.
